pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
From the evil of the darkness when it is intense
And from the evil of malignant witchcraft
And from the evil of the envier when he envieth

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
From the mischief of created things
From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads
From the mischief of those who practise secret arts
And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy
